title: EvalPassGate
description:
Workflow-level pass criterion.

Selects how [`AssertionResult`] rows roll up into the workflow's `pass / fail` outcome. Thresholds are in `[0.0, 1.0]`; out-of-range values are rejected by [`EvalPassGate::validate`].

threshold.description: Minimum accepted overall pass rate in `[0.0, 1.0]`.

oneOf.description:
Pass iff every `LlmJudge` task passes at the per-judge threshold.

Computed per judge, then AND-reduced across judges.

threshold.description: Minimum accepted per-judge pass rate in `[0.0, 1.0]`.
